card_name_eng: Trial of the Four Great Dragons
effect_description_eng:
[Main] ＜Draw 1＞ (Draw 1 card from your deck.) Then, place this card in your battle area.
[Main] ＜Delay＞ (By trashing this card after the placing turn, activate the effect below.)
・Play 1 Digimon card with the [Four Great Dragons] trait from your hand without paying the cost. The Digimon played by this effect can't digivolve to level 7, and at the end of your opponent's turn, delete that Digimon.
inherited_effect_description_eng: Security Effect [Security] Place this card in the battle area.
